endpoints.payload: (e: IpcMainEvent, catalog: WorshipToolsCatalog) => { if (!view || e.sender !== view.webContents) return const songs = sanitizeSongs(catalog?.songs) state.songs = songs state.serviceDetected = songs.length > 0 if (typeof catalog?.href === "string") state.url = catalog.href pushState() }
endpoints.expression: ipcMain.on(WT_CATALOG, (e: IpcMainEvent, catalog: WorshipToolsCatalog) => { if (!view || e.sender !== view.webContents) return const songs = sanitizeSongs(catalog?.songs) state.songs = songs state.serviceDetected = songs.length > 0 if (typeof catalog?.href === "string") state.url = catalog.href pushState() })
